tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Look up catalog details (name, price, images, product page URL) for a Mishimoto product SKU. Does not include live stock/availability.

sku.description: The Mishimoto product SKU to look up.

tools.name: get_products_for_vehicle
tools.description: Find Mishimoto products that fit a given vehicle by year, make, and model (optionally narrowed by trim, engine, or submodel). Returns SKU, name, categories, and product page URL for each match.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default 50).

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for pagination (default 0).

tools.name: get_related_content
tools.description: Find install guides/blog posts and videos related to a Mishimoto product SKU, as shown on the product's fits page.

sku.description: The Mishimoto product SKU to look up related content for.

tools.name: get_vehicles_for_product
tools.description: Look up which vehicles (year, make, model, submodel, trim, engine, body type/cab style) a Mishimoto product SKU fits. Matches the "Compatible Vehicles" table shown on the product page.

sku.description: The Mishimoto product SKU to look up.

limit.description: Maximum number of vehicles to return (default 100).

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for pagination (default 0).

tools.name: list_vehicle_options
tools.description: List valid values for a vehicle year/make/model/submodel/body type/engine/trim field, scoped to vehicles with compatible Mishimoto products. Use this to discover the exact spelling of a make or model before calling get_products_for_vehicle, instead of guessing.

field.description: Which field to list values for.

year.description: Optional: narrow to this model year.

make.description: Optional: narrow to this vehicle make.

model.description: Optional: narrow to this vehicle model.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Free-text search for Mishimoto products by name when an agent doesn't have an exact SKU or year/make/model (e.g. "cold air intake"). Returns SKU, name, price, and product page URL for each match.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (default 8).
